segments.sn56.27:1.3: Dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ, dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ, dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ –
segments.sn56.27:1.4: imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri ariyasaccāni tathāni avitathāni anaññathāni;
segments.sn56.27:2.1: “Tasmātiha, bhikkhave, ‘idaṃ dukkha’nti yogo karaṇīyo…pe… ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yogo karaṇīyo”ti.

lines: Sattame tasmā ariyasaccānīti yasmā tathāni avitathāni anaññathāni, tasmā ariyānaṃ saccānīti vuccanti.
Na hi vitathāni ariyā ariyasaccato paṭivijjhanti. 8.
